answers.whatIsTradelia: Tradelia is an independent lab that combines proprietary AI frameworks and academic methodology for financial research. We offer free access for everyone and professional on-demand services.
answers.howToStart: You can start by creating a free account. You'll have access to the dashboard, public reports, and basic courses. For advanced features, consider upgrading to Pro.
answers.whatIsPro: The Pro plan includes Portfolio Manager, Financial Calculator, Advanced Alert System, PDF Report Download, Custom Analysis Requests, and priority support.
answers.isFree: Yes, basic access is completely free and permanent. Professional services are optional and fund free access for everyone.
answers.mifidCompliant: Yes, all material is compliant with MiFID II regulations and international academic standards. Information is for educational purposes and does not constitute financial advice.
answers.businessPlans: Yes, we offer Business plans with B2B invoicing. Contact us for more information on business plans.

faq.contactUs: Didn't find the answer you were looking for? Contact us and we'll help you.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: Tradelia respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our platform.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.content: We only collect data necessary to provide our services: email for authentication, usage data to improve the platform, and payment information for Pro services (processed through secure providers).

dataUsage.title: Data Usage
dataUsage.content: Your data is used exclusively for: providing and improving our services, communicating with you, processing payments, and complying with legal obligations. We do not sell or share your data with third parties for marketing purposes.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: You have the right to access, correct, delete, or limit the processing of your personal data. You can also object to processing or request data portability. Contact us at support@tradelia.org to exercise these rights.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: For questions about the Privacy Policy, contact us at support@tradelia.org

whatAre.title: What Are Cookies
whatAre.content: Cookies are small text files saved on your device when you visit a website. We use cookies to improve your experience and provide essential functionality.

essential.title: Technical Cookies (Required)

analytics.title: Analytics Cookies
analytics.content: Cookies used to analyze site usage and improve user experience. You can disable these cookies in your browser settings.

management.title: Cookie Management
management.content: You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings. Note that disabling some cookies may limit some site functionality.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By using Tradelia, you accept these Terms and Conditions. If you do not accept, do not use the platform.

use.title: Service Use
use.content: Tradelia provides educational material and financial research tools. The material is for educational purposes and does not constitute financial advice. We are not responsible for investment decisions based on the material provided.

account.title: Account and Payments
account.content: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account. Payments for Pro services are processed through secure providers. Refunds are handled according to our refund policy.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.content: The material provided is for educational purposes and does not constitute financial advice, investment solicitation, or recommendation. All investments involve risks. Always consult a qualified financial advisor before making investment decisions.
